coordinate_system: Blender: X right, Y toward rear, Z up; front wall Y=-4. Origin at footprint centre on ground. Godot export converts axes.

door_proposal.swing: outward, as visible on the retained cutaway; keep external sweep clear, validate on player collider before approval

rear_wall_note: Rear wall is solid behind hearth and bed headboard. Sleeping daylight comes from right window. This replaces an early unshown rear-window proposal after the cutaway review.

habitation_zones.purpose: wet clothing, shoes, small storage by protected entrance
table and everyday work near front and right daylight
hearth and preparation; chimney directly above hearth, window beside work surface
sleeping area away from entrance; curtain or partition remains a proposal

zone_note: Functional zoning only, not a furnished interior or approved interior-transition implementation. Attic access and exact partitions need interior design later.
entry_mode_proposal: seamless: continuous player movement through opening and an animated physical door; no fade/scene teleport for H01

furniture: table and two chairs by front-right window
small preparation surface near left window
separate_objects: lock state in game script later
removable roof and attic floor for authoring
rules: Actual entrance hole, wall thickness and interior-facing surfaces; no solid whole-house box collider
Keep clear circulation from doorway to each usable object
Chest ownership/theft, lockpicking, NPC witnesses and saving remain future systems, not functionality supplied by a model
A sleeping-platform stove is reserved as a future alternate dwelling module, not combined with every hearth and bed

future_model_rules: Confirm image and dimensions with owner before production Blender.
Dimensions and opening IDs resolve AI-view ambiguities; never claim automatic image-to-mesh precision.
Main wall and roof volumes are separate; window shutters, entry door and movable props remain independent.
Fine shingle, grain and mortar detail belongs in shared materials; silhouette geometry only where it matters.
Do not bake clothing lines, gardens and yard items into every house mesh.
Keep entrance approach and future hinge/door-interaction anchors clear; seamless door behavior is a separate feature.
Qwen authors Blender geometry/scripts, Codex reviews and runs them; no script is commissioned before concept approval.
